cycles.method: Conservative V4 core-path bounds (16 cycles per ordinary instruction) from the native probe of the 0.2.2 source (evidence/probes.json, 4,353,132 executed cases; the hold adds three instructions to the SC_KEY frame path and nine to the plain one, and the probe checks the hold kept after KEY moves away, the hold taken from an OT frame into each soft mode, and its release on unmute). Event: one pass of the frame hook, once per 16-sample block; at most 3,440 (SC_KEY variant, OTFX; 2,176 plain). The per-trig hooks are separate events of at most 352 each (fresh bind); all eight tracks triggering in one block add at most 13,184, which tests.qualification counts per block (16,624). 390 is the largest measured MCF5206E model path. Budget: one 362.8 us frame at 264 MHz. Not chip wall-clock timing.
